history.summary: A large (1625 sqft) 3BR in a 160-unit 1996 condo at Tanjong Rhu, 260m from the new Tanjong Rhu TEL station. The lease (99yr from 1993, ~67yr remaining) is the key drag — it's crossing into the sub-70yr zone where financing tightens and depreciation accelerates — and the $1660 asking PSF is at the top of the recent $1500-1677 transacted range.
history.rating_rationale: The 260m walk to Tanjong Rhu MRT (TEL) and the established East Coast/Kallang Basin location are genuine strengths, and URA shows 4.1%/yr on a usable 26 txns. But ~67 years of lease remaining is a structural headwind (financing/CPF limits begin tightening under 60yr and buyers price the decay now), the development is old (1996) and only 160 units, and at $1660 PSF / $2.698M you're paying the top of the range with no value cushion. Not en-bloc marked, so no near-term redevelopment catalyst. Lowest score in the batch (357) reflects these drags. Location saves it from Avoid.
